text: そりゃ　つって　みなけりゃ　わからんよ！

structure.jp: つって　みなけりゃ

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: つって　みなけりゃ
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means 'try doing it and see'. つって　みなけりゃ = 'if you don't try fishing'.

patterns.name: 〜なければ
patterns.explanation: なければ means 'if not' or 'unless'; なけりゃ is the shortened spoken form. みなけりゃ = 'unless you try'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん on the end of a verb is an old-man or dialect form of ない, 'not'. わからん = わからない = 'won't know'.
